annotations.title: Metrics catalog: what can be queried

description: The catalog behind metrics_query: for posts, accounts and inbox, every metric with its unit and the channels that report it, the groupBy values, granularities, longest window and row limits, plus each channel's own reach and engagement vocabulary and which platforms share no per-post numbers. Read it once; it changes only when Hermoso adds a metric. Read-only, 0 credits.
